guarantees.claim: err_entropy_ready defaults to 0 and is set to 1 only when (st == StIdle) && (st_d == StMsgFeed) && kmac_en_i && !cfg_entropy_ready.

assumptions.claim: The combination (st == StIdle, st_d == StMsgFeed, kmac_en_i) represents a KMAC operation point that genuinely requires entropy.
assumptions.cond: when st == StIdle && st_d == StMsgFeed && kmac_en_i
assumptions.risk: If this state transition does not actually require entropy, a false err_entropy_ready will be raised, causing unnecessary fault handling.

assumptions.claim: cfg_entropy_ready is stable and accurately reflects the entropy source ready status when evaluated during this state transition.
assumptions.cond: when st == StIdle && st_d == StMsgFeed && kmac_en_i
assumptions.risk: A glitch or incorrect value on cfg_entropy_ready could falsely assert err_entropy_ready.

uncertain_points.claim: Only the transition from StIdle to StMsgFeed with kmac_en_i is checked for entropy readiness; other states where kmac_en_i is active and entropy is required may go unchecked.
uncertain_points.cond: when kmac_en_i is high in a state other than StIdle with st_d == StMsgFeed or when other entropy-critical transitions exist
uncertain_points.risk: KMAC could proceed with insufficient or absent entropy, compromising cryptographic security or causing silent data corruption.

uncertain_points.claim: err_entropy_ready is a combinational output that could glitch if cfg_entropy_ready changes while the enable condition holds.
uncertain_points.cond: when (st == StIdle) && (st_d == StMsgFeed) && kmac_en_i and cfg_entropy_ready toggles
uncertain_points.risk: A transient false error pulse might be latched downstream, leading to spurious fault assertions.
